meaning:
τρίβολος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Gen.3:18, Hos.10:8 (דַּרְדַּר), 2Ki.12:31 (חָרִיץ), Pro.22:5 (צֵן)* ;]
a thistle: Mat.7:16, Heb.6:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
